exposure: Caesarean section at full cervical dilatation
outcome: Rate of caesarean section at full cervical dilatation
cohort: Women with a singleton, cephalic presenting fetus at ≥37(0) weeks' gestation delivered by caesarean section in the second stage of labour
finding: The rate of caesarean section at full cervical dilatation at a tertiary unit was variable over the 5 years, with no observed trend.
mod_finding: The majority of women delivered by cesarean section at full cervical dilation were nulliparous and in spontaneous labor, with more than half delivered without a trial of instrumental delivery.
